lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba₄Al₄O₈ (reduced formula BaAlO₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Al centers in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors, while Ba centers have 10 geometric neighbors (4 Al, 6 O) and O centers are three-coordinate with 1 Al and 2 Ba neighbors. The connectivity forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Al tetrahedra and corner, edge, and face sharing between Al tetrahedra and Ba 10-vertex polyhedra.
